Estimated nutrition per 100 g — editable

Dates indicate estimated freshness, not safety. Unknown foods need your own date, portion, and nutrition information.

A little knowledge. In your hands.

Fridgekind is a course-project beta for choosing quick meals and tracking ingredients—not a cooking tutorial.

Editable estimates

Rounded reference nutrition is adapted from USDA legacy food composition values. Portions are approximate edible weights. Recipe totals reflect your saved portion and nutrition changes for available ingredients, and reference values for missing amounts.

Shelf-life defaults use conservative points from published storage ranges, with explicit food and storage assumptions. They cannot measure freshness or guarantee food safety. Changing storage does not erase previous time spent in storage; review actual history and package labels.

Sources: USDA FoodData Central · Nebraska Extension storage chart · FoodSafety.gov.

Saved only in this browser. No accounts or cloud sync. Recommendations use a fixed recipe collection and transparent matching rules, not live AI. Vegetarian/vegan filters are provided; allergy filtering is not supported. Check every ingredient.
